environment.description: Provider binary deployed in a distroless container image (gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12) orchestrated via Kubernetes with the pod spec setting `securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem: true`. No emptyDir, hostPath, or PVC volumes are mounted. The container's ephemeral storage request is set to 0. The Kubernetes node uses containerd 1.7+ with the default seccomp profile applied via RuntimeDefault annotation. Note: the provider process still receives signals normally (SIGUSR1 delivery is not blocked by seccomp RuntimeDefault profile, which permits kill/tgkill syscalls). The OCI runtime spec does NOT restrict signal delivery to the process.

config.volumes: none (no emptyDir, no hostPath, no PVC, no tmpfs)
